subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is the small red folded-paper boat in <Picture 1>. Its triangular upper fold and hull are made from thin matte red paper. The picture supplies its exact folds, colour and small handmade proportions.

summary: [reference generation] A realistic observational shot of <Subject 1> floating on a quiet garden pond. Gentle natural drift and a smooth lateral camera move make the scene visibly change while the paper boat behaves like a very light floating object.

retention_analysis: Preserve the red folded-paper construction, triangular fold, low paper hull and handmade proportions from <Picture 1>. Use the picture as identity guidance, not a fixed first or last composition. The subject remains a paper boat throughout.

detailed_description: [Shot 1] Natural live-action photography, one continuous five-second shot. A very light surface current carries <Subject 1> slowly to the right by about half its hull length over the whole shot. It bobs slightly and turns only a few degrees. Small soft ripples touch its sides and quickly settle into the surrounding water. The water stays calm, with a soft reflection close beneath the paper hull. A low camera slides smoothly sideways for forty centimetres and changes viewing angle by twenty degrees, revealing modest parallax between the boat, pond-edge plants and a distant wooden jetty. Most visible motion comes from this camera travel, not boat speed. Hold a medium-wide view with the entire paper boat and space around it visible from beginning to end; keep its apparent size nearly constant. Finish while it continues to drift gently.

overall_soundscape: Quiet garden ambience, a light breeze in nearby leaves and very soft water lapping. These quiet sounds match the slow motion. No dialogue or music.
